zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay指出Mark Zuckerberg表示即使H100的價值也高於去年，因AI算力仍稀缺，挑戰較舊$NVDA GPU快速貶值的想法。Meta因擁有數據中心而受益，可繼續使用已折舊GPU。同樣邏輯適用於$NBIS、$CRWV與$IREN，硬體生產力更長。

Mark Zuckerberg says “the value of even an H100 at this point is higher than it was last year” as AI compute remains scarce challenging the idea that older $NVDA GPUs quickly lose their value.

Thats also why Meta benefits from owning its data centers because it can keep using GPUs long after they're fully depreciated instead of paying cloud providers year after year.

The same logic extends to $NBIS, $CRWV and $IREN because if GPUs remain productive longer than expected then they can generate more revenue from the same hardware without needing to replace it as quickly.

ticker_notes.VIAV: 測試資格是光學擴產瓶頸

zh_summary: @KawzInvests 指出 OCP 峯會數據確認資格認證和測試仍是光學收發器大規模擴產的核心瓶頸。Celestica 數據顯示測試窗口持續壓縮：400G 36 個月、800G 24 個月、1.6T 18 個月。GPU 架構每 12 個月刷新，僅增加雷射晶圓產能無法解決問題。提到 $VIAV $AEHR $COHU $FORM $TER。
text:
Recent data at the OCP Summit confirms what has been clear for a while... qualification and testing remain the central gating factor for optical transceivers at scale.

Celestica's numbers show how testing windows have continuously compressed with each generation: 

> 400G: 36 months 
> 800G: 24 months 
> 1.6T: 18 months

With GPU architectures refreshing every 12 months and 224G per lane leaving no margin for error, the core structural thesis hasn't changed.

Ramping laser fab capacity doesn't solve the problem on its own if transceivers can't be validated and qualified fast enough to match the silicon cadence.
$VIAV $AEHR $COHU $FORM $TER

name: Shay Boloor

ticker_notes.NVTS: 與NVDA開發24kW電源板，效率提升

zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 報告 $NVTS 與 $NVDA 共同開發用於 MGX 生態系的 24 kW 電源板，將 800V 直接轉換為 12V 供下一代 AI 機架使用。Navitas 執行長目標是透過消除轉換步驟將電力更靠近 GPU。1.5 個百分點效率提升可為每 GW AI 容量釋放約 15 MW，使 Navitas 在 Nvidia 為 Vera Rubin 打造的電力基礎設施中佔得先機。
text:
$NVTS just unveiled a 24 kW power board developed with $NVDA for its MGX ecosystem converting 800V directly to 12V for the next generation of AI racks.

Navitas CEO says goal is to “bring power closer to the GPU” by eliminating an entire conversion step that would otherwise waste electricity as heat.

Even a 1.5 percentage point efficiency improvement could free up ~15 MW for every GW of AI capacity to power more compute giving Navitas an early position in the power infrastructure Nvidia is building for Vera Rubin.

text:
Mark Zuckerberg says his AI agent took him from ordering Instacart “twice a year” to “twice a week” which is ~50x more often just by making shopping easier.

Thats what makes agent commerce so interesting because removing effort of buying things could dramatically increase how often people shop rather than just shifting existing purchases online.

And as personal agents start communicating directly with business agents, $META could own both sides of the interaction while $AMZN and $MELI benefit from more transactions flowing through their platforms.

name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 指出，UBS 認為 2027 年是 $CBRS 的拐點年，營收將成長約 4 倍至 33 億美元，並在 2030 年達到約 230 億美元，營業利潤率為 46%。他表示，隨著 AI 代理每項任務需要數十次模型調用，Cerebras 的晶片內記憶體優勢變得更有價值，CS-5 目標在 2027 年達到每位用戶每秒 1 萬個 token；他也提到合約積壓訂單約 250 億美元，而股價目前不到 2028 年盈利的 20 倍。
text:
UBS sees 2027 as the inflection year for $CBRS with revenue growing ~4x to $3.3B before reaching ~$23B by 2030 with 46% operating margins.

The interesting part is Cerebras’s on chip memory advantage becomes way more valuable as AI agents make dozens of model calls per task with CS-5 targeting 10K tokens per second per user in 2027.

And with ~$25B in contracted backlog already equivalent to nearly half of projected revenue from 2027 through 2030, shares now trade below 20x 2028 earnings.

name: Gene Munster

ticker_notes.META: 個人化機器人黏著度高，可順利變現

zh_summary: @munster_gene 表示，Muse、Grok Bot 和 Dot 這類個人化機器人黏著度極高，因此 AI 從補貼階段轉向付費階段應會很順利，就像搜尋一樣。他說這有助於解釋為何 $META 今天上漲 4%，而納斯達克下跌 2%，原因是其新的 Muse Wonder Bot 模型將收取每月 20 美元或 100 美元。
text:
Once you've used these personalized bots (Muse, Grok Bot, Dot) the thought of going back to a life without them is painful. 

This means the transition from the subsidy phase of AI to the paying phase will be smooth, because once it becomes core to our lives, monetization will appear. Just look at Search. 

That reality helps explain why $META is up 4% today, Nasdaq down 2% on the new Muse Wonder Bot model that they will charge $20 or $100 a month.
